AWS Project Rainier / Amazon New Carlisle campus
status_as_of_cutoff: Partial live / operating-source evidence. IDEM's permitted-source register lists Amazon Data Services Incorporated sources at 55001 Larrison Blvd. and 31100 SR 2 in New Carlisle as Operating, with permit dates in 2025. Amazon's June 24, 2025 Project Rainier announcement says Project Rainier was fully operational and that St. Joseph County, Indiana is one of the Project Rainier sites; Anthropic's April 20, 2026 announcement says it is using over one million Trainium2 chips with Amazon/AWS. No public building-by-building completion, certificate-of-occupancy, energized-load, or campus full-buildout record was found, so this is not treated as full campus buildout.

actions.exact_result_status: IEDC announced AWS plans to invest $11 billion in an Indiana Enterprise Center campus over the next decade and offered performance-based state incentives; this is not a local approval.
actions.access_caveat: Official state page accessible; it does not publish a county/town vote tally or a building-by-building completion register.
